shop.desc: Items you can use on this website. Includes EXP boosts, weapons, skins, etc.

items.EXPToken: Points earned for completing activities on Mighty platform.
items.TimeStone: When used, gives an extra 10 seconds to answer a question in Mind battle. Destroyed when used.
items.ExpPotion: Increases the amount of EXP received while playing / learning by 30% for 1 hour.  If you consume more than 1 bottle, the effect will still be the same (30%).
items.AmethystStone: Increases the amount of EXP received by 10% for 30 days. If you consume more than 1 stone, the effect will still be the same
items.BloodTalisman: Gives an extra Daily Quest. Cooldown: 14 days. Warning: use it only after quest has been used once.
items.EmperorKey: Allows you to buy any course for free.

coursespage.header: Study, complete tests and earn EXP
coursespage.desc: You can choose any course in any field. Currenty there are only programming courses available, but we are working towards adding alot more in the future!
coursespage.subDesc: The course contents are regularly updated.
